UserObject.mermaidData:
{
  "data": "erDiagram
    users {
        bigserial id PK
        varchar_150 name
        varchar_100 email UK
        varchar_255 password
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    roles {
        bigserial id PK
        varchar_255 name
        varchar_255 guard_name
    }

    model_has_roles {
        bigint role_id PK, FK
        varchar_255 model_type PK
        bigint model_id PK
    }

    kompetensi_keahlian {
        serial id PK
        varchar_100 nama_jurusan
        varchar_20 acronym
    }

    siswa_profiles {
        bigint user_id PK, FK
        varchar_20 nis UK
        varchar_50 kelas
        int kompetensi_keahlian_id FK
        text alamat
        varchar_20 no_telp
    }

    guru_profiles {
        bigint user_id PK, FK
        varchar_30 nip UK
        varchar_50 jabatan
        int kompetensi_keahlian_id FK "Nullable"
    }

    periode_pkl {
        serial id PK
        varchar_100 nama
        date tanggal_mulai
        date tanggal_selesai
        boolean status_aktif
    }

    perusahaan {
        bigserial id PK
        varchar_150 nama
        text alamat
        varchar_20 telp
        int kuota_saran
    }

    pengajuan_pkl {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint siswa_id FK
        bigint perusahaan_id FK
        int periode_pkl_id FK
        varchar_50 status
        varchar_100 nomor_pengajuan UK "Nullable, terisi saat PDF Surat Pengajuan di-generate (BR18)"
        bigint kaprog_id FK "Nullable"
        text catatan_kaprog
        timestamp verified_kaprog_at
        bigint hubin_id FK "Nullable"
        timestamp surat_dikirim_at
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    pengajuan_pkl_histories {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint pengajuan_id FK
        varchar_50 from_state
        varchar_50 to_state
        bigint actor_id FK
        text catatan "Nullable"
        timestamp created_at
    }

    surat_pengantar {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint perusahaan_id FK
        int periode_pkl_id FK
        varchar_100 nomor_surat UK
        date tanggal_terbit
        bigint generated_by FK
        varchar_255 file
    }

    surat_pengantar_pengajuan {
        bigint surat_pengantar_id PK, FK
        bigint pengajuan_id PK, FK
    }

    penugasan_pembimbing {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint guru_pembimbing_id FK
        bigint pengajuan_id FK
        bigint assigned_by FK "Kaprog, eksklusif"
        varchar_20 status "aktif / nonaktif, default aktif"
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp ended_at "Nullable, diisi saat status jadi nonaktif"
    }

    surat_tugas_monitoring {
        bigserial id PK
        varchar_20 lingkup "global / scoped"
        int kompetensi_keahlian_id FK "Nullable, null jika lingkup=global"
        int periode_pkl_id FK
        bigint requested_by FK "Nullable, kaprog (null jika global)"
        bigint diterbitkan_by FK "hubin"
        varchar_100 nomor_surat UK
        date tanggal_terbit
        varchar_255 file
        enum status "aktif / nonaktif, default aktif"
        date berlaku_hingga "Nullable, null = berlaku penuh periode"
        timestamp created_at
    }

    kunjungan_monitoring {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint penugasan_id FK
        bigint surat_tugas_id FK "Wajib, gate BR22"
        date tanggal_kunjungan
        text catatan
        string dokumentasi_path "Nullable, foto/video (bisa banyak path)"
        timestamp created_at
    }

    notifications {
        uuid id PK
        varchar_255 type
        varchar_255 notifiable_type
        bigint notifiable_id
        text data
        timestamp read_at "Nullable"
        timestamp created_at
    }

    penilaian {
        serial id PK
        int kompetensi_keahlian_id FK "Nullable - NULL = Indikator Umum (global, semua jurusan)"
        int kelompok_tujuan "1/2/3/4 - sesuai Tujuan Pembelajaran Formulir Penilaian; 3 = Teknis Kejuruan (wajib jurusan terisi)"
        varchar_255 nama_indikator
        int urutan
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    section_penilaian {
        serial id PK
        bigint penilaian_id FK
        varchar_255 nama_sub_indikator
        int urutan
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    formulir {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint penugasan_id FK "ke penugasan_pembimbing, 1x penilaian"
        varchar_50 status "draft / submitted"
        date tanggal_penilaian
        varchar_150 nama_pembimbing_industri
        int sakit "hari"
        int izin "hari"
        int alpa "hari, tanpa keterangan"
        text catatan_guru_pembimbing
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    nilai {
        bigserial id PK
        bigint formulir_id FK
        bigint penilaian_id FK "Wajib"
        bigint section_penilaian_id FK "Nullable"
        decimal skor
        timestamp created_at
        timestamp updated_at
    }

    %% Relasi Auth & RBAC
    users ||--o| roles : "has via model_has_roles"
    roles ||--o{ model_has_roles : "assigned to"

    %% Relasi Profil & Master
    users ||--o| siswa_profiles : "extends to"
    users ||--o| guru_profiles : "extends to"
    kompetensi_keahlian ||--o{ siswa_profiles : "belongs to"
    kompetensi_keahlian ||--o{ guru_profiles : "supervised by (Kaprog)"

    %% Relasi Pengajuan Transaksional
    siswa_profiles ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl : "submits"
    perusahaan ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl : "targeted by"
    periode_pkl ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl : "defines"
    guru_profiles ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl : "verified by (Kaprog/Hubin)"
    pengajuan_pkl ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl_histories : "audit trail (BR17)"
    users ||--o{ pengajuan_pkl_histories : "as actor"

    %% Relasi Surat Pengantar
    perusahaan ||--o{ surat_pengantar : "addressed to"
    periode_pkl ||--o{ surat_pengantar : "valid for"
    guru_profiles ||--o{ surat_pengantar : "generated by (Hubin)"
    surat_pengantar ||--o{ surat_pengantar_pengajuan : "contains"
    pengajuan_pkl ||--o{ surat_pengantar_pengajuan : "linked to"

    %% Relasi Pembimbingan & Monitoring
    guru_profiles ||--o{ penugasan_pembimbing : "acts as pembimbing / assigner (Kaprog, eksklusif)"
    pengajuan_pkl ||--|| penugasan_pembimbing : "monitored via (histori + aktif)"
    kompetensi_keahlian ||--o{ surat_tugas_monitoring : "scoped to (nullable = global)"
    periode_pkl ||--o{ surat_tugas_monitoring : "valid for"
    guru_profiles ||--o{ surat_tugas_monitoring : "requested by (Kaprog, nullable) / generated by (Hubin)"
    surat_tugas_monitoring ||--o{ kunjungan_monitoring : "authorizes (gate, BR22)"
    penugasan_pembimbing ||--o{ kunjungan_monitoring : "tracks"

    %% Relasi Notifikasi
    users ||--o{ notifications : "notifiable (polymorphic)"

    %% Relasi Penilaian PKL
    kompetensi_keahlian |o--o{ penilaian : "scoped to (nullable = Indikator Umum, global)"
    penilaian ||--o{ section_penilaian : "has sub (nullable)"
    penugasan_pembimbing ||--|| formulir : "generates 1x penilaian"
    formulir ||--o{ nilai : "contains"
    penilaian ||--o{ nilai : "referenced by"
    section_penilaian ||--o{ nilai : "referenced by (nullable)"
",
  "config": null
}
